meta.title: Changelog — what's new on Vendora
meta.description: A running log of features, improvements, and fixes shipped to Vendora — the marketplace + planning tools for event hosts and vendors.

title: What we've been <gold>shipping.</gold>
intro: The features, improvements and fixes you'll notice, newest first. No marketing fluff, just the work.

explore_redesigned.title: Explore, redesigned
explore_redesigned.description: Browse vendors' work in a two-column gallery, watch reels one at a time, and find every vendor and the ones you've saved, all from one page.

vendors_page_look.title: A new look for the vendors page
vendors_page_look.description: Browse by category with photo tiles, keep your filters in view while you scroll, and see each vendor in a taller card.

host_vendor_pages.title: Pages for hosts and for vendors
host_vendor_pages.description: What Vendora does for someone planning an event, and what it does for event businesses, each have their own page now. The home page is simpler.

how_it_works.title: How it works, step by step
how_it_works.description: A new page walks hosts and vendors through Vendora, from the first search or listing to a confirmed booking.

one_look.title: One look across the website and apps
one_look.description: Libre Baskerville for every word, one set of colours, gold buttons and flat cards, the same on the website and in both apps.

listing_drafts.title: Save a listing as a draft
listing_drafts.description: Vendors can save a listing part-way through and come back to finish it later.

block_several_days.title: Block several days at once
block_several_days.description: In the vendor app's calendar, pick any set of days and block them in one go.

unanswered_badge.title: Unanswered inquiries at a glance
unanswered_badge.description: The Inbox tab in the vendor app shows a badge with how many inquiries are waiting for a reply.

password_reset_links.title: Password reset links work again
password_reset_links.description: The reset link in the email no longer says it has expired when it hasn't.

vendor_messaging.title: Vendor-to-vendor messaging
vendor_messaging.description: Vendors can message each other directly to coordinate on shared events, photographer to planner or florist to DJ, without looping in the host.

verification_badges.title: Verification badges
verification_badges.description: Vendors can send identity, insurance and business-licence documents for review. Approved checks show as badges on their profile and cards.

english_spanish.title: English and Spanish
english_spanish.description: The website follows your browser's language, in English or Spanish, and you can switch at the bottom of any page.

city_category_pages.title: City and category pages
city_category_pages.description: Every city with vendors has its own page, and category pages answer the questions people ask most.

faster_page_loads.title: Faster page loads
faster_page_loads.description: Photos come in smaller, modern formats, and the next page starts loading as soon as you point at its link.
